description: BiRefNet (general) RGBA cutouts, enclosed holes filled (TypesetMatteRefine), and mask-derived subject anchor. Caller normalizes to supplied fps and extraction dimensions: project dimensions for legacy footage, native aspect for a selected layer (analysis.matteSource maps local pixels/time in the renderer). Long clips run once per chunk (frame_offset, raw=true, unload_model only on the last chunk), with tracks merged by core_vision.merge_track_chunks.
